sampler_hypothesis.kind: curated source hypothesis; no GPU timing or candidate implementation
sampler_hypothesis.lineage: qwen_gpu_handoff correlated source review plus root call-site inspection
sampler_hypothesis.observation: dr3_sample executes top-k insertion, full-logit exp denominator and weighted draw in thread zero; only the semantic/EOS head reaches main sampling.
invariants: Denominator includes every logit, in the current serial Float32 order.
Top-p always retains rank zero and excludes the crossing candidate.
Weighted draw uses ordered subtraction and last-retained fallback.
Main first and retry draws are always computed; preserve deterministic draw slots and retry semantics.
sampler_hypothesis.falsifier: Actual-shape paired batches of 189 calls with fixed 4097/4096 logits, k=30 and precomputed draws, one final drain; include ties and top-p boundary cases and compare selected IDs. Rank against projection/convolution attribution before implementation.
sampler_hypothesis.residual: Parallel denominator reassociation can change cutoff decisions; Qwen top-2 is a structural precedent only, not a drop-in resident sampler. No speed or default claim.

next_timing_probe.scope: Correlated read-only source analysis; root checked whole-command timer, Context.submit and sample call sites. No probe executed or speed established.
observations: Metal bridge exposes command GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime, not per-dispatch timestamps.
The async graph collects elapsed GPU time at existing waits; command buffers can mix tower/backbone/main sampling.
Component host profiler adds finishes and cannot attribute the unchanged async path.
Context.sample also dispatches the finite-input guard.

next_falsifier.inputs: Fixed preloaded 4097/4096 logits, deterministic draws and k30; actual-shape fixed hidden/projection input.
next_falsifier.schedule: Warm resource/pipeline setup separately, then isolated repeated sampler and projection command buffers at graph depth 2, submit both, finish once; alternate order in paired repeats.
next_falsifier.output_check: Compare selected IDs including ties/cutoffs; retain finite guard and exact draw slots.
next_falsifier.interpretation: Whole-buffer GPU durations estimate operator-group magnitude; they are not production end-to-end speedups.
